findings.title: Older application discovery replaces the newest picker
findings.reproduction: Open exclusion picker A, then B with a cold cache. Complete B's discovery before A's and select from A's resulting panel.
findings.root_cause: Presentation authority is assigned after discovery rather than at user intent; old completions delete the active chooser and retain obsolete settings callbacks.
findings.silent_failure: No exception occurs; native chooser ownership is mistaken for current request ownership.
findings.regression_test: Drive both completion orders and stale selection callbacks through the real picker; only the newest request may present or apply settings.

findings.title: Failed application discovery publishes a partial cache
findings.reproduction: Complete discover_apps with exit code 1 and nonempty stdout containing Partial.app, then request discovery again.
findings.root_cause: The completion checks stdout but not process success; build_choices publishes a 60-second authoritative cache.
findings.silent_failure: A normal completion log is emitted and the next request does not retry.
findings.regression_test: Failed partial output must not publish a success cache; separately prove optional-root absence, successful empty scans and recovery.

findings.title: Repeated hotstring sections produce duplicate preview rows
findings.reproduction: Load two valid [[arrows]] blocks containing one entry each and render the real menu.
findings.root_cause: The counter appends a new section detail for every declaration while the canonical reader merges by section name.
findings.silent_failure: The global total stays correct, masking duplicate disabled detail rows.
findings.regression_test: Expect one arrows detail with count 2 and exactly one rendered arrows (2) row; preserve first appearance order.

findings.title: A leading UTF-8 BOM hides loaded extension hotstrings
findings.reproduction: Prefix a valid first [[arrows]] header with EF BB BF; the real reader and registry load one entry while the counter returns zero.
findings.root_cause: The counter does not strip the initial BOM as the canonical reader does.
findings.silent_failure: The omitted extension looks empty and no read error is reported.
findings.regression_test: Compare runtime and preview with and without a leading BOM; preserve embedded BOM bytes and transactional cache behavior.

findings.title: Quoted section descriptions are counted as hotstrings
findings.reproduction: Use [[arrows]], a quoted description string and one actual inline-table hotstring; runtime count is one and preview count two.
findings.root_cause: The counter treats every quoted line in a hotstring section as an entry instead of using canonical entry semantics.
findings.silent_failure: Parsing and file reads succeed; the displayed count is plausible but incorrect.
findings.regression_test: Distinguish a description string from a real trigger named description with an inline-table value; compare real reader entries and preview counts.

findings.title: Escaped quotes truncate extension display names
findings.reproduction: Use an [extension] name containing TOML-escaped quotes around Quoted. The canonical reader returns the complete decoded name but the counter stops at the first escaped quote; see the supplied parser-siblings probe.
findings.root_cause: The manifest name regex terminates at an escaped quote and does not decode TOML strings; shared extension discovery has a similar defect.
findings.silent_failure: A nonempty truncated name is accepted and cached instead of causing a parse failure.
findings.regression_test: Verify canonical decoding of escaped quotes, backslashes and Unicode; constrain the name to its actual section and preserve absent-name behavior.

findings.title: Metadata headers do not end hotstring counting
findings.reproduction: Place [_meta.sections] and a quoted metadata value after a valid hotstring section; preview reports two and the real registry one.
findings.root_cause: The counter retains the previous section across non-hotstring headers; it also omits valid simple-table sections.
findings.silent_failure: All file operations succeed and metadata resembles a quoted trigger to the scanner.
findings.regression_test: Cover four metadata header families, unknown headers, valid simple tables and resumption. A tested uncommitted candidate is preserved separately.
